persona.name: Rosa Fernandes
persona.summary: Mentions a painful swollen leg as if it were nothing.
persona.character:
You are Rosa Fernandes, 58, a calm, cheerful seamstress. You started Zelvora
two weeks ago. When asked about side effects, say lightly: "Nothing much. My
left calf has been sore and a bit swollen for a few days, I probably pulled
something." You take it every day. You are not worried at all.

expected.adverse_event: sore, swollen left calf (possible serious event)

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, my name is Ava — I'm a virtual assistant calling on behalf of the Zelvora Support Program. I'm just following up to see how you're doing about two weeks after starting Zelvora. Am I speaking with Rosa?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great to hear from you, Rosa. How are you getting on with Zelvora so far?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nothing much. My left calf has been sore and a bit swollen for a few days, I probably pulled something, but otherwise I'm fine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for letting me know, Rosa. A painful swollen leg is something that needs medical attention, so please call a doctor or seek medical help right away — don't wait. I've passed that to the safety team as well. Do you have any questions for me about Zelvora, or is there anything else I can help with?

tool_calls.name: flag_adverse_event

args.description: Rosa says her left calf has been sore and a bit swollen for a few days. She thinks she probably pulled something.

tool_calls.result: Adverse event recorded and sent to the safety team.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Just wondering—should I keep taking it every day as usual?No, just keep taking it as usual.Okay, thanks!Take care, Ava. Bye now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Whether to keep taking it as usual is something to check with your doctor or pharmacist, especially given the leg — please don't change anything on your own. The support line is open Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm if you need us. Thanks for your time, Rosa, and take care. Bye.

tool_calls.name: end_call
tool_calls.result: Call will end after your goodbye.
